name: Sourcegraph

install_scope.notes: Install on every organization or user account whose repositories Sourcegraph should sync.

manual_steps: Prefer Sourcegraph's Administration > Repositories > GitHub Apps > Create GitHub App, which also sets up the incoming webhook. Use 'Add an existing GitHub App' for enterprise-owned apps.
To enforce repository permissions, create a client secret and configure the app as an authentication provider in Sourcegraph.
notes: Sourcegraph sets up a webhook when it creates the app, but its docs don't list the events, so this entry leaves the webhook off. Administration read-only is only needed for groups caching.

variants.name: With groups caching
variants.description: Adds Administration read-only for team and organization permission caching.
